title: C2 Milestone 7
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has completado el Milestone 7. Tu dominio del Subjuntivo Formal, los Modismos de Alta Gerencia, el vocabulario de Disrupción y las 'Cleft Sentences' es la marca de un verdadero líder innovador y elocuente.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu maestría en las lecciones recientes: 

1. The Formal Subjunctive: 
- I demand that he RESIGN (no 'resigns'). 
- It is crucial that she BE informed. 
- They suggested that we NOT GO. 

2. Advanced Business Idioms: 
- Move the needle (marcar la diferencia). 
- Boil the ocean (intentar lo imposible). 
- Push the envelope (innovar/ir al límite). 
- Kick the can down the road (posponer).
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 7, Leadership and Innovation. This exam will test your mastery of recent lessons. First, the Formal Subjunctive. For example: I demand that he RESIGN. It is crucial that she BE informed. They suggested that we NOT GO. Second, Advanced Business Idioms, such as: move the needle, boil the ocean, push the envelope, and kick the can down the road.

parts.visual:
3. Tech & Disruption Vocabulary: 
- Paradigm shift (cambio fundamental). 
- Disruptive innovation (innovación que cambia el mercado). 
- Bleeding edge (vanguardia extrema). 
- Scalability (capacidad de crecer). 
- Pivot (cambiar de estrategia). 

4. Cleft Sentences (Emphasis): 
- WHAT we need IS more time. 
- IT WAS the CEO WHO resigned. 
- ALL I want IS an answer. 
- WHAT he did WAS resign.
parts.audio: Third, Tech and Disruption Vocabulary. Words like paradigm shift, disruptive innovation, bleeding edge, scalability, and pivot. Finally, Cleft Sentences for emphasis. Examples include: WHAT we need IS more time. IT WAS the CEO WHO resigned. ALL I want IS an answer. And WHAT he did WAS resign. Good luck!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio en este examen de consolidación.

questions.question: The board demands that the CFO ____ the new financial report tomorrow.
It is essential that the servers ____ updated immediately.
questions.explanation: Subjuntivo del verbo to be: be.

questions.question: Small tweaks to the logo won't ____ the needle on our sales. (Marcar una diferencia notable).
Instead of fixing the core software issue, they just kicked the ____ down the road by releasing a tiny patch.
questions.explanation: Kick the can down the road = posponer un problema grave.

questions.question: The shift from physical stores to e-commerce was a massive ____ shift in retail.
Normal: I need a vacation. -> Emphasis: ____ I need is a vacation.
Normal: John made the error. -> Emphasis: It was John ____ made the error.
The lawyer advised that his client ____ to the police without representation.
questions.explanation: Negación en subjuntivo: not + verbo base.

questions.question: Let's focus on one city first; if we try to launch globally on day one, we'll just ____ the ocean.
The startup had to ____ from making hardware to developing software because they ran out of money.
Normal: He resigned. -> Emphasis on the action: What he ____ was resign.
It is imperative that every manager ____ this training session.
We want to be innovative, so we must constantly push the ____.
questions.explanation: Push the envelope = innovar, ir al límite.

questions.question: Because of smartphones, MP3 players are now almost entirely ____.
Normal: I only want a chance to explain. -> Emphasis: ____ I want is a chance to explain.
questions.explanation: All I want is... (The only thing I want).

questions.question: We use ____-edge technology. It's so new that sometimes it crashes, but it keeps us ahead of competitors.
questions.explanation: Bleeding edge = vanguardia extrema con riesgo.

questions.question: Let's target the ____-hanging fruit first to get some quick sales this quarter.
Normal: They bought a new software. -> Emphasis on software: It was a new software ____ they bought.
questions.explanation: It was a new software that...

questions.question: I don't have the data right now, so let me ____ back to you on that next week.
questions.explanation: Circle back = retomar el tema después.

questions.question: I request that my subscription ____ canceled immediately.
It is crucial that he (to be) ____ informed.
I demand that she (to resign) ____.
Move the ____. (Marcar diferencia con N)
____ the ocean. (Abarcar demasiado con B)
A ____ shift. (Cambio de paradigma con P)
____ edge. (Vanguardia absoluta con B)
____ we need is a plan. (Lo que con W)
It was John ____ did it. (Quien con W)
____ I want is a coffee. (Todo lo que con A)
The technology is ____. (Obsoleta con O)
